title: Artificial Seawater Based AMP1 Medium Preparation
author: Bonnie Poulos
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.c9mz45
materials: Primary Trace Metal Stocks (ZnSO₄, CoCl₂, MnCl₂, Na₂MoO₄, NaSeO₃, NiCl₂)
Dispense into 500 ml acid-washed polycarbonate bottles.
Weigh out 0.2175 g Na₂EDTA·2H₂O using dust free paper. Ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid disodium salt dihydrate Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #E4884
Weigh out 0.16 g FeCl₃·6H₂O using dust free paper. Iron(III) chloride hexahydrate Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #44944
Adjust volume to 50 ml mark with MQ-water.
Dispense into 500 ml acid-washed polycarbonate bottles
Weigh out 0.2175 g Na 2 EDTA·2H 2 O using dust free paper undetermined Ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid disodium salt dihydrate Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #E4884
Weigh out 0.16 g FeCl 3 ·6H 2 O using dust free paper undetermined Iron(III) chloride hexahydrate Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #44944
Adjust volume to 50 ml mark with MQ-water

steps.title: Dissolve salts sequentially
steps.instruction: Dissolve each required salt completely before adding the next one, using the quantities listed in the provided salt table.

steps.title: Adjust pH of NaH2PO4
steps.instruction: Adjust the pH of the NaH2PO4 solution to 7.5 with 1 M NaOH, adding approximately 8 mL of NaOH per 100 mL of solution; prepare this solution separately.

steps.title: Filter‑sterilize NaH2PO4 solution
steps.instruction: Pass the NaH2PO4 solution through a 0.2 µm syringe filter into sterile 50 mL centrifuge tubes or acid‑washed sterile polycarbonate bottles.

steps.title: Store NaH2PO4 and dispense for medium
steps.instruction: Store the filtered NaH2PO4 solution at 4 °C. When preparing the final medium, dispense 250 µL of this solution per 500 mL bottle of Turk’s Island Salt Mix.

steps.title: Adjust pH of HEPES
steps.instruction: Adjust the pH of the HEPES solution (Fisher Scientific Catalog #BP310) to 7.5 with 1 M NaOH, adding about 9 mL of NaOH per 50 mL of solution; prepare this solution separately.

steps.title: Filter‑sterilize HEPES solution
steps.instruction: Filter‑sterilize the HEPES solution through a 0.2 µm syringe filter into sterile 15 mL or 50 mL centrifuge tubes or acid‑washed sterile polycarbonate bottles.

steps.title: Store HEPES and prepare NaHCO3 monthly
steps.instruction: Store the filtered HEPES solution at 4 °C. Prepare NaHCO3 monthly and store it at 4 °C as well.

steps.title: Dispense NaHCO3 and HEPES for medium
steps.instruction: When making the final medium, add 5 mL of NaHCO3 and 0.5 mL of HEPES to each 500 mL bottle of Turk’s Island Salt Mix.

steps.title: Prepare trace metal flask
steps.instruction: Transfer 40 mL of Milli‑Q water into an acid‑washed 50 mL volumetric flask.

steps.title: Dissolve EDTA in flask
steps.instruction: Add EDTA to the flask and dissolve by inverting several times; if necessary, heat at 80 °C for 5 minutes to achieve full dissolution.

steps.title: Dissolve iron chloride
steps.instruction: Add iron chloride to the same flask and dissolve by inverting several times.

steps.title: Add individual trace metal stocks
steps.instruction: Individually add and dissolve 50 µL each of ZnSO₄, CoCl₂, MnCl₂, Na₂MoO₄, NaSeO₃, and NiCl₂ (primary trace metal stocks), mixing after each addition.

steps.title: Filter‑sterilize trace metal stock
steps.instruction: Filter the completed trace metal solution through a 0.2 µm syringe filter into a sterile, acid‑washed container inside a laminar flow hood.

steps.title: Store trace metal stock
steps.instruction: Store the sterile trace metal stock at 4 °C.

steps.title: Dispense trace metal stock for medium
steps.instruction: When preparing the final medium, dispense 5 µL of the trace metal stock into each 500 mL bottle of Turk’s Island Salt Mix.
